findings.title: Excessive delay penalties calculated on total contract value
findings.deviation: The penalty rate is 1% (standard is 0.5%) and the cap is 10% (standard is 5%), both calculated on the total Contract Value rather than the affected milestone, with no relief for client-caused delays.
findings.impact: AtliQ risks high penalties for minor delays even if they only affect a small part of the project or are caused by the client.
findings.quote: the Service Provider shall pay to the Company, by way of liquidated damages and not as a penalty, an amount equal to one percent (1%) of the Contract Value for each week or part thereof of delay. The aggregate liquidated damages payable under this Clause 12 shall not exceed ten percent (10%) of the Contract Value.
findings.counterPosition: 0.5% of the affected milestone fee per week, capped at 5% of that milestone fee; no LDs where the delay is caused by the client; LDs are the sole and exclusive remedy for delay.

findings.title: Uncapped liability for data protection breaches
findings.deviation: Liability for data protection (Clause 13) is carved out of the aggregate liability cap, leaving it unlimited.
findings.impact: AtliQ faces unlimited financial risk in the event of a guest data breach or regulatory incident.
findings.quote: Save in respect of liability arising from fraud, wilful misconduct, breach of Clause 7 (Confidentiality) or Clause 13 (Data Protection), each Party's aggregate liability under this Agreement shall not exceed the Contract Value.
findings.counterPosition: Mutual cap of 1× fees paid or payable in the 12 months before the claim; data-protection liability under a separate super-cap (e.g. 2× fees).

findings.title: Exclusion of work-in-progress from convenience termination payment
findings.deviation: The clause only guarantees payment for services 'performed and accepted', whereas the standard requires payment for all work done including work in progress.
findings.impact: AtliQ may not be compensated for efforts expended on unaccepted milestones or work in progress if the client terminates early.
findings.quote: in which event the Company shall pay for all Services performed and accepted up to the date of termination.
findings.counterPosition: Payment for all services performed up to termination, including work in progress and committed costs; mutual notice period.

findings.title: Lack of mutual general indemnity for breach
findings.deviation: The agreement provides specific indemnities for IP and materials but lacks a mutual indemnity covering each party's general breach or negligence.
findings.impact: AtliQ is not protected against third-party claims arising from the client's negligence or contractual breaches.
findings.quote: The Service Provider shall indemnify the Company against all losses, claims and expenses arising from any claim by a third party that the Deliverables infringe the intellectual property rights of such third party... The Company shall indemnify the Service Provider against claims arising from the Service Provider's use... of materials supplied by the Company.
findings.counterPosition: Each party indemnifies the other for third-party claims caused by its own breach or negligence; no indemnity for losses caused by the indemnified party's own negligence.

fine.note: Ownership of specific deliverables transfers upon payment, and Background IP is correctly retained by AtliQ with a license granted.
Confidentiality obligations are mutual in substance and include standard survival terms.
The agreement does not contain any non-compete or non-solicit restrictions.
Performance and conformance warranties match standard industry practice.
